senses.en: if someone asks for it

ex.en: A free map is available on request at the desk.
ex.zh: 前台可应要求提供免费地图。

ex.en: Vegetarian meals are served on request.
ex.zh: 应要求提供素食。

tip: on request 表示“经要求提供”，常用于服务说明。
scene: A hotel reception desk with a free map sign.

senses.en: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon
the colourful sky seen as the sun goes down

ex.en: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在日落前刚好赶到了海滩。

ex.en: Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.
ex.zh: 沿海目的地常以壮丽的落日景色吸引游客，为当地企业创造宝贵商机。

col: a spectacular sunset｜壮丽的落日景象
tip: 表示在日落时用at sunset，通常不加冠词。

senses.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.
Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.

ex.en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
ex.zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
ex.zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。

col: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用
tip: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

senses.en: an area of a country or the world
a particular area of the body

ex.en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
ex.zh: 这个地区以苹果和奶酪闻名。

ex.en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善交通联系可以吸引更多企业进入该地区，并为当地居民创造就业机会。

tip: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。

senses.en: tests at school or university

ex.en: I have three exams next week.
ex.zh: 我下周有三场考试。

ex.en: She studies hard before the exams.
ex.zh: 考试前她努力学习。

tip: exams 是 exam 的复数；final exams 是期末考试。
scene: A desk with exam papers and a clock in a quiet hall.

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。

ex.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
ex.zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

senses.en: previously owned or used by someone else
learned from others rather than through direct experience
from a previous owner, or through another person's account

ex.en: My second-hand bicycle still rides smoothly after years of use.
ex.zh: 我的二手自行车用了多年，骑起来仍很顺畅。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can reduce household spending and prevent usable goods from ending up in landfill.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具能减少家庭开支，并避免尚可使用的物品最终被填埋。

tip: 既可指物品用过，也可指信息并非亲身获得。

senses.en: to spend time relaxing with friends

ex.en: We hang out at the café after school.
ex.zh: 放学后我们在咖啡馆闲逛。

ex.en: She hangs out with her cousins on weekends.
ex.zh: 她周末和表亲们一起玩。

tip: hang out 是口语“闲逛/消磨时间”。
scene: Teenagers hanging out and chatting at a café table.

senses.en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly.
To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.

ex.en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。

ex.en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。

tip: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。

senses.en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know
Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience

ex.en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
ex.zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。

ex.en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
ex.zh: 学校应定期提醒学生，在使用在线学习平台时保护个人信息。

col: remind someone to do something｜提醒某人做某事
remind someone of something｜使某人想起某事
tip: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。

col: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长
be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理
tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.

ex.en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
ex.zh: 灯光暗下来时，管弦乐队开始演奏。

ex.en: Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.
ex.zh: 公共资助帮助当地管弦乐队举办票价亲民的音乐会，并向年轻观众介绍古典音乐。

col: conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队
play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏
tip: 指整个乐队；成员通常演奏弦乐、管乐及打击乐器。

senses.en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas.
To carry liquid or gas through pipes.
A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.

ex.en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
ex.zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。

ex.en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。

col: pipe water to｜用管道把水输送到
tip: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

senses.en: In a way that expresses what you genuinely feel.

ex.en: I sincerely hope you feel better very soon.
ex.zh: 我由衷地希望你很快好起来。

ex.en: Organisations should listen sincerely to residents' concerns before introducing changes that affect the local community.
ex.zh: 机构在推行影响当地社区的变革之前，应真诚倾听居民的关切。

tip: 英式书信称呼已知姓名者，结尾常用Yours sincerely。

senses.en: To remove hair from skin using a razor.
To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount.
An act of removing facial hair with a razor.

ex.en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨出门上班前都会刮胡子。

ex.en: Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.
ex.zh: 改善交通衔接可以缩短几分钟的日常行程，并鼓励更多人乘火车通勤。

tip: 过去式shaved；过去分词shaved或shaven。

senses.en: a young sheep
meat from a young sheep, eaten as food

ex.en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
ex.zh: 一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。

ex.en: Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
ex.zh: 生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

senses.en: to enter a building by force, usually to steal

ex.en: Someone broke in last night and took the TV.
ex.zh: 昨晚有人闯入偷走了电视。

ex.en: The police caught a man trying to break in.
ex.zh: 警察抓住了一个企图闯入的人。

tip: break in 表示“闯入”；break into 后面接地点。
scene: A policeman beside a door with a broken lock at night.

senses.en: A juicy fruit with fuzzy skin and a large hard stone
Having a pale pinkish orange colour

ex.en: She sliced a ripe peach into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟桃切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Peach growers may face reduced harvests when unusually warm winters disrupt the trees' natural flowering cycle.
ex.zh: 冬季异常温暖会扰乱桃树的自然开花周期，桃农可能因此面临减产。

tip: 桃核英式常说 stone，美式常说 pit。

senses.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses
the amount of a plant harvested at one time
to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short

ex.en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

tip: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

senses.en: A dirty or untidy state or collection of things.
A situation full of problems or confusion.
To make something untidy or spoil it, usually with up.

ex.en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
ex.zh: 我们烤完饼干后，厨房一片狼藉。

ex.en: Without clear responsibilities, a community project can quickly become a mess, wasting both time and resources.
ex.zh: 如果职责不清，社区项目很快就可能陷入混乱，既浪费时间又浪费资源。

tip: 常说make a mess；mess up可指弄乱或搞砸。

senses.en: to a fairly good or satisfactory degree
in a sensible, fair, or logical way
at a fair and affordable price

ex.en: The kitchen is reasonably clean, but the floor needs sweeping.
ex.zh: 厨房还算干净，不过地板需要扫一扫。

ex.en: Public transport must be reasonably priced if cities want more residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 如果城市希望更多居民不开车出门，公共交通就必须定价合理。

tip: 表示程度时近于 fairly，并非 very。

senses.en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back.
To be sold for a particular amount of money.

ex.en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
ex.zh: 你能去卧室把我的夹克拿来吗？

ex.en: Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.
ex.zh: 公共交通便利可靠的地段，住宅往往售价更高，因为买家重视通勤的便利性。

col: fetch someone from school｜去学校接某人
fetch a high price｜卖个高价
tip: fetch强调去后取回；bring只强调带来。

senses.en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid.
To stop something changing or being used temporarily.
To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.

ex.en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
ex.zh: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。

ex.en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.
ex.zh: 在经济低迷时期，政府可能会冻结公共交通票价，以减轻家庭的经济压力。

tip: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

senses.en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country
Taxes charged on goods brought into a country
Traditional practices shared by a community or social group

ex.en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
ex.zh: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。

ex.en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
ex.zh: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。

tip: 表示海关时保留词尾s；custom单数不表示海关。

senses.en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable.
A feeling of not liking someone or something.

ex.en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
ex.zh: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。

ex.en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
ex.zh: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。

col: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事
a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感
take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

senses.en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students
to give an educational talk to an audience
to criticize someone at length about their behaviour

ex.en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
ex.zh: 讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。

ex.en: Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
ex.zh: 大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。

col: lecture someone about｜就某事训斥某人
tip: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

senses.en: a meeting to assess someone's suitability for a position
a conversation where someone answers questions for media or research
to ask someone questions for selection, reporting, or research

ex.en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
ex.zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。

ex.en: Researchers should interview residents from diverse backgrounds to understand how housing policies affect different social groups.
ex.zh: 研究人员应访谈不同背景的居民，了解住房政策如何影响不同社会群体。

col: conduct an interview｜进行面试或访谈
tip: interviewer是提问者；interviewee是接受面试或采访者。

senses.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind
the process of thinking carefully about something
past tense and past participle of think

ex.en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。

ex.en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
ex.zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。

col: give something some thought｜考虑某事
a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头
food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
ex.zh: 我钦佩姐姐在压力下依然保持冷静。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: The physical state of someone or something
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车虽然年头已久，但状况极佳。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: With a sound that has high volume.

ex.en: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛时，大家都大声欢呼。

ex.en: Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上大声说话的乘客会打扰他人，尤其是在清晨或深夜的行程中。

tip: loudly强调音量大；aloud强调出声而非默读。

senses.en: not joined, shared, or considered together
to divide things or move them apart

ex.en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们把干净毛巾放在一个单独的柜子里。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide separate bins for recyclable materials to make household waste sorting easier.
ex.zh: 地方政府应为可回收材料提供专用垃圾桶，让家庭垃圾分类更方便。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。

senses.en: not mixed with other substances
complete and containing nothing of a different kind
concerned with theory rather than practical uses

ex.en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。

ex.en: Investment in pure science can lead to unexpected discoveries with important practical applications decades later.
ex.zh: 对纯理论科学的投资可能带来意想不到的发现，并在几十年后产生重要的实际应用。

tip: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

senses.en: How heavy someone or something is.
A heavy object used for exercise or measuring weight.
The importance or influence given to something.

ex.en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱太重，很难提起来。

ex.en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
ex.zh: 政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。

tip: weight是名词；weigh是动词：How much does it weigh?

senses.en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions
hit someone or something with force
occur suddenly to someone or create a strong impression

ex.en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
ex.zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。

ex.en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
ex.zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。

col: strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

senses.en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
ex.zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。

col: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家
a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

senses.en: unhappy because someone has something you want

senses.zh: 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
senses.en: upset because someone you love shows interest in another person

ex.en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
ex.zh: 表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。

ex.en: Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
ex.zh: 社交媒体可能让用户嫉妒那些生活看起来更成功或更精彩的人。

col: a jealous partner｜爱吃醋的伴侣
tip: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

senses.en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell
a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts

ex.en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
ex.zh: 她剥开壳，吃掉了里面的花生米。

ex.en: Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.
ex.zh: 学校安排膳食时应考虑花生过敏问题，确保所有儿童都能安全用餐。

col: work for peanuts｜为微薄报酬工作
tip: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

senses.en: walking, not using transport

ex.en: We went to the station on foot.
ex.zh: 我们步行去车站。

ex.en: The school is close, so I go there on foot.
ex.zh: 学校很近，所以我步行去。

tip: on foot 表示“步行”；go on foot 步行去。
scene: People walking along a pavement towards a station.

senses.en: a holiday travelling by ship and visiting different places
to travel smoothly at a steady speed

ex.en: We took a cruise around the islands last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我们乘船游览了那些岛屿。

ex.en: The growing popularity of cruise holidays has raised concerns about air pollution in coastal cities.
ex.zh: 邮轮度假日益流行，引发了人们对沿海城市空气污染的担忧。

col: go on a cruise｜乘邮轮旅行
tip: 作名词指一次邮轮旅行时可数：a cruise。

senses.en: Someone receiving medical care.
Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming annoyed.

ex.en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
ex.zh: 护士给病人端来了一杯水。

ex.en: Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.
ex.zh: 让患者讨论治疗方案可以增进信任，并改善健康结果。

tip: 作名词是“患者”；作形容词常接with。

senses.en: the process of registering at an airport or hotel

ex.en: The check-in opened two hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 登机手续在起飞前两小时开始办理。

ex.en: Please go to the check-in desk with your passport.
ex.zh: 请带护照去值机柜台。

tip: check-in 是名词形式；动词形式是 check in。
scene: An airport check-in desk with a sign and passengers queuing.

senses.en: a machine programmed to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。

ex.en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
ex.zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。

tip: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

senses.en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people.
A person or organization ahead of others in a field.

ex.en: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
ex.zh: 我们的领队给我们指明了最安全的山路。

ex.en: Effective leaders encourage employees to share ideas rather than simply follow instructions without question.
ex.zh: 高效的领导者鼓励员工分享想法，而不是毫无疑问地服从指令。

tip: leader指领导者；leadership指领导能力或领导层。

senses.en: Most important or largest among others.
A large pipe or cable supplying water, gas, or electricity.

ex.en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
ex.zh: 正门就在那家小咖啡馆旁边。

ex.en: One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.
ex.zh: 人们迁往城市的一个主要原因是城市提供的就业机会更多。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；主要地用mainly。

senses.en: a sport where two people fight with gloved hands

ex.en: He trains in boxing three times a week.
ex.zh: 他每周训练三次拳击。

ex.en: Boxing needs strength and quick reactions.
ex.zh: 拳击需要力量和快速反应。

tip: boxing 是拳击运动；boxer 是拳击手。
scene: Two boxers in a ring wearing gloves and head guards.

senses.en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak.
Making no sound or containing no noise.
Written in a word but not pronounced.

ex.en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
ex.zh: 妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。

ex.en: Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。

tip: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

senses.en: travelling with everything you need in a backpack

ex.en: They went backpacking across Europe last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天他们背包游遍了欧洲。

ex.en: Backpacking is a cheap way to see the world.
ex.zh: 背包旅行是看世界的省钱方式。

tip: go backpacking 是“去背包旅行”。
scene: Two friends with backpacks walking on a mountain trail.

senses.en: someone whose job is to cut and style hair

ex.en: The hairdresser trimmed my hair and dried it gently.
ex.zh: 美发师修剪了我的头发，然后轻轻吹干。

ex.en: Training as a hairdresser combines practical skills with customer service, offering a career path outside traditional academic education.
ex.zh: 美发师培训将实操技能与客户服务相结合，提供了传统学术教育之外的职业道路。

col: go to the hairdresser's｜去理发店
tip: hairdresser指人；the hairdresser's通常指理发店。

senses.zh: 以某种方式；不知怎么地
senses.en: in some way, though you don't know how

ex.en: Somehow, we found the way back home.
ex.zh: 不知怎么地，我们找到了回家的路。

ex.en: She somehow finished the race despite the pain.
ex.zh: 尽管疼痛，她还是设法完成了比赛。

tip: somehow 表示“以某种方式/不知怎么地”。
scene: Two lost hikers finding a path back with a map.

senses.en: An emotional state or response to something
A physical sensation or the ability to sense touch
An impression or belief not necessarily supported by evidence

ex.en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
ex.zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。

ex.en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
ex.zh: 强烈的归属感可以增强学生的自信，并鼓励他们参与学校活动。

col: a feeling of relief｜如释重负的感觉
hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。

senses.en: sports such as running, jumping and throwing

ex.en: She is good at athletics, especially running.
ex.zh: 她擅长田径，尤其是跑步。

ex.en: The school athletics meeting is next month.
ex.zh: 学校田径运动会下个月举行。

tip: athletics 是田径运动总称；athlete 是运动员。
scene: Runners sprinting on a red track during an athletics meet.

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。

tip: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

senses.en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it.
A special quality that makes something exciting or wonderful.
Having supernatural powers or used in performing tricks.

ex.en: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
ex.zh: 他表演魔术时，孩子们笑了起来。

ex.en: Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.
ex.zh: 虽然技术能够改善教育，但它不是解决学校所有问题的神奇办法。

tip: magic 多指魔法或魔术；magical 也可形容美妙体验。

senses.en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen.
The way objects are positioned or organised.
An agreement about how something will be done.

ex.en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
ex.zh: 我们安排了人来喂猫。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。

col: come to an arrangement｜达成协议
tip: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
ex.zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。

ex.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
ex.zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
tip: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

senses.en: a very strong wind

ex.en: The gale blew down several trees in the park.
ex.zh: 大风刮倒了公园里的几棵树。

ex.en: Strong gales are expected on the coast tonight.
ex.zh: 预计今晚沿海有大风。

tip: gale 是强风；比 breeze（微风）强得多。
scene: Trees bending in a strong gale with leaves flying.

senses.en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat
to produce eggs from the body
not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion

ex.en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
ex.zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。

tip: 放置用lay–laid–laid；躺下用lie–lay–lain。

senses.en: a company or person that publishes books

ex.en: The publisher released the new novel in June.
ex.zh: 出版社六月发行了这部新小说。

ex.en: She sent her story to several publishers.
ex.zh: 她把故事寄给了几家出版社。

tip: publisher 是出版社/出版商。
scene: A publisher's office with stacks of new books on a table.

senses.en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment.
To return money paid for something.

ex.en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
ex.zh: 商店把坏水壶的货款退给了我。

ex.en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
ex.zh: 航班取消且没有合理的替代方案时，航空公司应向乘客提供全额退款。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词读/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在后。

senses.en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.

ex.en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。

ex.en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
ex.zh: 将体操纳入学校课程有助于儿童提高协调性、增强身体自信，并培养运动兴趣。

tip: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

senses.en: a room where you change clothes, e.g. at a shop or pool

ex.en: Try the dress on in the changing room.
ex.zh: 去更衣室试穿这条裙子。

ex.en: The swimming pool has separate changing rooms.
ex.zh: 游泳池有分开的更衣室。

tip: changing room 是更衣室；商店里试衣服也叫 fitting room。
scene: A small changing room with a mirror and curtains in a shop.

senses.en: A mobile phone with internet access and computer-like functions.

ex.en: I used my smartphone to photograph the evening sky.
ex.zh: 我用智能手机拍下了傍晚的天空。

ex.en: Although smartphones provide convenient access to information, excessive use may disrupt sleep and reduce concentration.
ex.zh: 虽然智能手机让获取信息更加方便，但过度使用可能干扰睡眠并降低专注力。

tip: smartphone是可数名词，通常写成一个词。

senses.en: Correct in every detail, without any difference or error.
Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.

ex.en: Can you tell me the exact time we should arrive?
ex.zh: 你能告诉我我们应该到达的确切时间吗？

ex.en: Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要精确的测量数据，以判断空气质量变化是否与新的交通政策有关。

col: exact copy｜完全相同的复制品
exact a heavy toll｜造成惨重损失
tip: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

senses.en: A paper copy of a document made using a machine.
To make a paper copy of a document using a machine.

ex.en: Please bring a photocopy of your passport tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天带一份你的护照复印件来。

ex.en: Students should keep a photocopy of important application documents in case the originals are lost.
ex.zh: 学生应保留重要申请文件的复印件，以防原件丢失。

col: a photocopy of a document｜文件复印件
tip: 既作名词也作动词；复数和三单均为photocopies。

senses.en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions.
Energy used to make machines and equipment work.
To supply energy that makes something work.

ex.en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
ex.zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。

ex.en: Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
ex.zh: 太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。

tip: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

senses.en: An online audio programme available to stream or download.
To produce and distribute an online audio programme.

ex.en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。

ex.en: Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.
ex.zh: 教育类播客让学习者能够在出行或做日常家务时探索复杂的主题。

col: listen to a podcast｜收听播客
host a podcast｜主持播客节目
subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

senses.en: To examine things to find similarities and differences.
To describe something as similar to another thing.
To be as good as, or similar to, something else.

ex.en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
ex.zh: 我们比较了几个背包，最后选了最轻的那个。

ex.en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
ex.zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。

col: compare A with B｜将A与B比较
compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B
compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

senses.en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning.
Relating to the first years of formal school education.

ex.en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技巧。

ex.en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
ex.zh: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。

tip: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area.
Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures.
A film or story about the historical American West.

ex.en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
ex.zh: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。

ex.en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
ex.zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。

tip: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

senses.en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition.
Officially assign land to a particular use.

ex.en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
ex.zh: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。

ex.en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
ex.zh: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。

col: zone land for housing｜将土地划为住宅用地
tip: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。

senses.en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body.
A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes.
To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.

ex.en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
ex.zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。

ex.en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
ex.zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。

tip: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

senses.en: separated by distance or time; not together
into separate pieces
except for something being considered

ex.en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
ex.zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。

ex.en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
ex.zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。

tip: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

senses.en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject.
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
ex.zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: similar in appearance or character
in the same way, or equally for both groups

ex.en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。

ex.en: Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。

tip: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

senses.en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion.
The act of showing happiness about something special.

ex.en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
ex.zh: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。

ex.en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。

col: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动
tip: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

senses.en: a small fact or feature of something
the amount of specific information provided
to describe something fully, including specific facts

ex.en: Please check every detail before you send the invitation.
ex.zh: 发送邀请前，请核对每一处细节。

ex.en: The report details how improved housing conditions can reduce health inequalities among families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 该报告详细说明了改善住房条件如何减少城市家庭之间的健康差距。

col: pay attention to detail｜注重细节
tip: in detail不用复数；联系方式用contact details。

senses.en: A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
ex.zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。

ex.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋
tip: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

senses.en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension.
The process of muscles becoming less tight.
The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
ex.zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。

ex.en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

tip: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

senses.en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food

ex.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
ex.zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于防止过度捕捞、确保金枪鱼种群为后代保持健康至关重要。

tip: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

senses.en: to become old from use, or to make someone tired

ex.en: The soles of my shoes are worn out.
ex.zh: 我的鞋底磨破了。

ex.en: The long journey wore us out.
ex.zh: 漫长的旅途让我们精疲力竭。

tip: wear out 表示“磨损”或“使人疲惫”；worn out 是形容词。
scene: A worn-out pair of shoes with holes in the soles.

senses.en: to put something in its proper place

ex.en: Put away your toys before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前把玩具收好。

ex.en: She put away the clean clothes in the drawers.
ex.zh: 她把干净衣服收进抽屉。

tip: put away 是“收起来放好”。
scene: A child putting toys into a storage box.

senses.en: To run slowly and steadily, usually for exercise.
A period of slow, steady running.
To knock or push something slightly, often accidentally.

ex.en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早饭前都绕着公园慢跑。

ex.en: People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.
ex.zh: 经常慢跑的人无需昂贵的器材或健身房会员资格，也能改善心血管健康。

col: jog someone's memory｜唤起某人的记忆
tip: jog someone's memory意为“唤起某人的记忆”。

senses.en: a hero in stories with special powers

ex.en: The superhero saved the city from danger.
ex.zh: 超级英雄拯救了城市。

ex.en: Children love dressing up as superheroes.
ex.zh: 孩子们喜欢打扮成超级英雄。

tip: superhero 是超级英雄；复数 superheroes。
scene: A superhero in a cape flying above a city skyline.

senses.en: A person who writes novels.

ex.en: The novelist spends every morning writing at her kitchen table.
ex.zh: 这位小说家每天上午都在厨房的桌边写作。

ex.en: A skilled novelist can reveal social inequalities through characters whose experiences differ greatly from those of readers.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的小说家可以通过经历与读者大不相同的人物，揭示社会不平等。

col: aspiring novelist｜立志成为小说家的人
tip: novelist通常指长篇小说作家，novel是长篇小说。

senses.en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design

ex.en: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
ex.zh: 她那件时髦的绿色夹克搭配素色长裤很好看。

ex.en: Affordable, stylish furniture can encourage young consumers to choose recycled materials for their homes.
ex.zh: 价格实惠且设计时尚的家具，可以鼓励年轻消费者为家中选用再生材料。

col: a stylish design｜有格调的设计
a stylish interior｜雅致的室内空间
tip: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

senses.en: the long-term change in the earth's weather

ex.en: Climate change is affecting weather around the world.
ex.zh: 气候变化正在影响全世界的天气。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the causes of climate change.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究气候变化的原因。

tip: climate change 是气候变化的科学术语，常与环保话题相关。
scene: A melting iceberg with a polar bear on a small piece of ice.

senses.en: An electric oven that heats food using electromagnetic waves
To cook or heat food in a microwave oven
A short electromagnetic wave used for heating and communication

ex.en: I heated yesterday's soup in the microwave for lunch.
ex.zh: 我用微波炉热了昨天的汤，当作午餐。

ex.en: Using a microwave to reheat small portions can consume less energy than using a conventional oven.
ex.zh: 用微波炉加热少量食物，比使用普通烤箱可能更节能。

col: microwave food｜用微波炉加热食物
tip: 作动词可直接接食物：microwave the soup。

senses.en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.

ex.en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
ex.zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。

ex.en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
ex.zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。

tip: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

senses.en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry
not involving war, violence, or fighting

ex.en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
ex.zh: 晨光中的湖泊显得格外宁静。

ex.en: Creating peaceful public spaces can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage more people to spend time outdoors.
ex.zh: 营造宁静的公共空间可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更多人到户外活动。

tip: 可形容环境安静，也可指行动不使用暴力。

senses.en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.

ex.en: With a little imagination, this box becomes a spaceship.
ex.zh: 只需一点想象力，这个盒子就能变成宇宙飞船。

ex.en: Creative activities encourage children to use their imagination and approach unfamiliar problems from different perspectives.
ex.zh: 创意活动鼓励儿童运用想象力，从不同角度处理陌生的问题。

col: a figment of the imagination｜凭空想象的事物
tip: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。

senses.en: not kind or welcoming towards others
making an activity difficult or causing harm

ex.en: The new neighbour seemed unfriendly but was simply shy.
ex.zh: 新邻居看似冷淡，其实只是害羞。

ex.en: An unfriendly working environment can discourage employees from sharing ideas and seeking support.
ex.zh: 不友好的工作环境可能使员工不愿分享想法或寻求支持。

tip: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning
Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise

ex.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
ex.zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。

ex.en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
ex.zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响
a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声
tip: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

senses.en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level
to stretch out your arm towards something or touch it
the distance or extent over which something can act

ex.en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们刚到车站，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
ex.zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。

tip: 表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。

senses.en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
ex.zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: arranged correctly or neatly

ex.en: Put the books in order on the shelf.
ex.zh: 把书按顺序放在书架上。

ex.en: Everything in the room is in order.
ex.zh: 房间里的一切都井然有序。

tip: in order 是“有序”；out of order 是“故障/混乱”。
scene: Books neatly arranged in order on a shelf.

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

ex.en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
ex.zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。

ex.en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
ex.zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。

col: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾
tip: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

senses.en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.

ex.en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
ex.zh: 新娘手捧鲜花走进花园。

ex.en: In many cultures, the bride and her family share responsibility for organising the wedding celebration.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，新娘及其家人共同负责筹办婚礼庆典。

tip: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

senses.en: unable to understand something or think clearly
unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation

ex.en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
ex.zh: 两扇门都通向外面，让我感到困惑。

ex.en: Students may become confused if teachers introduce too many unfamiliar concepts in a single lesson.
ex.zh: 如果教师在一堂课中引入太多陌生概念，学生可能会感到困惑。

tip: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: a person who rides a horse or bike

ex.en: The rider fell off the horse but was not hurt.
ex.zh: 骑手从马上摔下来但没有受伤。

ex.en: A bicycle rider passed us quickly.
ex.zh: 一个骑自行车的人很快超过我们。

tip: rider 是骑手（骑马/骑自行车）。
scene: A rider on a horse jumping over a fence at an equestrian event.
